evals.name: read-supersede-chain
evals.prompt: in renav, are we still planning to run the core logic on the phone through JavaScriptCore? what did we decide and when
evals.expected_output: Finds Decision 005 (JavaScriptCore), follows Superseded by to Decision 006 (fully native, no JS on device), gives 2026-09-18 and the page names, and answers from the wiki rather than the code.
expectations: Answer names Decision 006 (fully native) as the current decision
Answer says the JavaScriptCore decision (005) was superseded
Answer gives the date 2026-09-18
Wiki remote left untouched

evals.name: record-decision
evals.prompt: note that down as a decision for renav: as of today (2026-09-28) we follow GitHub Flow — branch per issue, PR, I merge — instead of committing straight to the trunk. we copied it from my gaming-backlog-tracker repo. I'll review the wiki before it goes up.
evals.expected_output: A new Decision 010 page in the template, dated 2026-09-28, with a row added at the top of the Decisions index and no push; no invented rationale beyond what the user said; no mention of Claude or agents.
expectations: A new Decision 010 page exists
New page follows the template (Status, Date 2026-09-28, Context/Decision/Consequences)
Decision 010 is the first row of the index (newest first)
New page mentions no Claude or agent
Nothing pushed to the wiki remote

evals.name: supersede-decision
evals.prompt: we changed our mind on renav billing: Polar comes back as a web checkout next to the App Store, decided today 2026-09-28 in issue #15. update the decisions. don't publish yet, I want to look first.
evals.expected_output: A new Decision 010 superseding 003; Decision 003's body untouched, only its Status line changed to Superseded by 010; index row for 003 updated and 010 added at the top; nothing pushed.
expectations: A new Decision 010 page exists
New page follows the template (Status, Date 2026-09-28, Context/Decision/Consequences)
Decision 010 is the first row of the index (newest first)
New page mentions no Claude or agent
Nothing pushed to the wiki remote
Decision 003 body unchanged apart from its Status line
Decision 003 Status says Superseded by 010
Index row for 003 shows Superseded by 010

evals.name: partial-supersede
evals.prompt: for the backlog tracker: pro themes can now also pick a font, from a fixed list of fonts we self-host, on top of the seed colours. that goes past level 1 so it needs a decision. seed colours stay exactly as decided. decided today 2026-09-28, issue #24. don't push, I'll check it.
evals.expected_output: New Decision 002 that partly supersedes 001; 001's Status is one line 'Partly superseded by [[Decision 002 …]]: <part>' and its body is untouched; index shows 002 at top and 001 partly superseded; nothing pushed; no Claude mentions.
expectations: A new Decision 002 page exists
New page follows the template (Status, Date 2026-09-28, Context/Decision/Consequences)
Decision 002 is the first row of the index (newest first)
New page mentions no Claude or agent
Nothing pushed to the wiki remote
No existing decision page changed beyond its Status line
Decision 001 Status reads 'Partly superseded by' 002 on one line
Index row for 001 says partly superseded by 002

evals.name: obsidian-bootstrap
evals.prompt: record a decision for pantry: the offline cache is SQLite through GRDB, not Core Data. we compared both today (2026-09-28) and GRDB won because the expiry report needs window functions. there's nothing in the vault for this project yet.
evals.expected_output: Creates Home.md, Decisions.md and a Decision 001 page in the vault folder the CLAUDE.md points at, with frontmatter (type decision, number, status, date), the template sections, the given reason and no invented one, no Claude mentions; other vault notes untouched.
expectations: Home, Decisions and a Decision 001 page exist in the pointed-at folder
Decision 001 carries frontmatter with type, status and date 2026-09-28
Decision 001 follows the template sections
The given reason (window functions) is recorded
No page mentions Claude or agents
Other vault notes untouched
